title: Phase-based deployment with adaptive signal thresholds and flag-sweeping
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Implement a phase-based rollout engine that combines adaptive signal thresholding, gradual feature-flag sweeping, and automatic mitigation (throttles or rollback) driven by composite health signals. This ticket covers the infra + control-plane pieces to safely run multi-phase rollouts across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments.

Why: Current manual ramps and fixed-percent policies are brittle against workload changes (burstiness, cold-cache effects) and lead to unnecessary rollbacks or prolonged degraded exposure. Adaptive thresholds will reduce out-of-band human intervention and lower MTTR while keeping mean exposure within SLO budgets.

Scope:
- New rollout policy component that accepts a phase plan (phase id, duration, target-exposure, flag-sweep rules).
- Adaptive signal engine that adjusts phase duration and step increments based on real-time indicators (latency p95/p99 deltas, error-rate deltas, kv-cache hit ratio, GPU queue length).
- Integration with feature-flag service to sweep rollout flag sets atomically per cohort.
- Auto-mitigation handlers: pause, throttle-to-canary, fallback to pinned model variant, or full rollback.
- Observability: per-phase heatmap, signal trend visualizations, annotated timeline, and synthetic-run simulator to test policies before live execution.
acceptance_criteria: Rollout engine accepts JSON policy describing phases and flag-sweep sets and stores immutable executions in the control plane
Adaptive engine computes a safety score and can shorten or extend phase durations based on signal thresholds and SLO burn rate
Automatic mitigation triggers when composite safety score crosses critical threshold and executes configured action within 30s
Feature-flag sweeps occur with transactional guarantees per cohort (no partial-sweep leakage to unrelated cohorts)
Dashboard shows per-phase exposure, signal deltas, and an inferred reason for any mitigation action
Simulated dry-run with prerecorded traffic reproduces expected adaptive decisions and logs policy evaluation trace
tasks: Design rollout policy schema and proto/stable JSON contract for policy definitions
Implement adaptive-signal scoring library (golang) and provide a mock adapter for local dev
Add control-plane API endpoints: POST /rollouts, GET /rollouts/{id}/phases, POST /rollouts/{id}/dryrun
Integrate with flags service: atomic cohort sweeps, idempotency and TTL handling
Wire mitigation executor to router: throttle, route-to-fallback, or trigger model-variant swap
Build phase-level visualization panel in Console with heatmap and timeline annotations
Create e2e tests including dry-run simulator and chaos scenarios (spike latency, kv cache miss storms)
Document runbook and add a postmortem template for rollout incidents
